newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Asustek surges on ex-bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Asustek surges on ex-bonus issue.

text.p: Taiwan's motherboard maker Asustek Computer Inc soared in early trade on Monday, its ex-bonus issue day, as investors rushed to buy the company's shares on hopes of high profits.
After 40 minutes trade, at 0140 GMT, Asustek had jumped by the daily seven percent limit or T$23 to T$357.
Asustek is to issue a stock dividend of T$15 per share, the highest of all Taiwan's listed firms' 1996 dividend issues.
"Investors are attracted by Asustek's high profit and high dividend. So many people want to be its shareholders," said Wang Jieh, an analyst of Foremost Investment.
Brokers said the performance of Asustek would determine whether electronics would remain the market's leading sector.
"People will see Asustek's performance as an indicator," Ben Lee, a senior analyst of Nomura Securities, said.
But Asustek's early rise failed to inspire other electronic shares.
The entire electronic sector was down 0.50 percent.
